beats.text: What if they spent thirty three million to stop one man and he won anyway?
Abdul El-Sayed beat Mike Rogers by seven points
and he is now the first Muslim ever elected to the United States Senate.
So what if he runs for president in twenty twenty eight?
Day one he signs Medicare for all
and every hospital bill in your drawer just disappears.
because a president needs sixty senators to pass it
and his party has fifty four.
